otherFeatures: 22 preset EQs + custom EQ in soundcore app
Battery: 60 mAh x2 earbuds, 430 mAh case
Model number A3949 (shared hardware with soundcore P20i / P25i)

bluetooth.notes: Official A3949 manual pairing illustration shows 'soundcore R50i'; its text says to select 'soundcore R50i / P20i / P25i' and that the name may vary by region (same hardware is sold as soundcore P20i / P25i and would then advertise that name). Pattern excludes 'soundcore R50i NC' (model A3959, a different product with ANC and a kickstand case). Google Fast Pair support not confirmed by any official source.

pairingSteps: Charge the earbuds and case fully before first use (remove the insulation stickers on the earbuds).
Open the charging case and take both earbuds out; they power on and enter Bluetooth pairing mode automatically.
On the Android phone open Settings > Bluetooth and select 'soundcore R50i' (name may vary by region).
To enter pairing mode manually: with the earbuds out of the case, tap and hold the touchpads on both earbuds for 3 seconds.

If pairing fails: delete the earbuds from the phone's Bluetooth list, take them out of the case and, within 1 minute of power-on, tap and hold both touchpads for 10 seconds until a sound plays (reset), then pair again.
